# sonatyperepo_security_oauth2 (Resource)

Configure Sonatype Nexus Repository OAuth2 / OpenID Connect (OIDC) authentication.

**Requires Nexus Repository Pro 3.94.0 or later**, with `nexus.security.oauth2.enabled=true` and `nexus.jwt.enabled=true` set in `nexus.properties`. The underlying API does not exist on earlier versions - applying this resource against an older server fails with a clear error rather than a panic.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sonatyperepo_security_oauth2" "oauth2_config" {
  idp_jws_algorithm     = "RS256"
  username_claim        = "preferred_username"
  first_name_claim      = "given_name"
  last_name_claim       = "family_name"
  email_claim           = "email"
  groups_claim          = "groups"
  use_trust_store       = false
  client_id             = "nexus-repository-client"
  client_secret         = "changeme"
  idp_authorization_url = "https://idp.example.com/oauth2/authorize"
  idp_token_url         = "https://idp.example.com/oauth2/token"
  idp_logout_url        = "https://idp.example.com/oauth2/logout"
  idp_jwks_url          = "https://idp.example.com/oauth2/jwks"

  # Optional, provider-specific extras
  authorization_custom_params = {
    prompt = "consent"
  }
  exact_match_claims = {
    aud = "nexus-repository-client"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `idp_jws_algorithm` (String) JWT signature algorithm used to validate tokens issued by the OpenID Provider - e.g. RS256
- `username_claim` (String) Claim used as the unique identifier for the user

### Optional

- `authorization_custom_params` (Map of String) Additional custom parameters sent with the authorization request
- `client_id` (String) Client ID issued by the OpenID Provider for this Nexus Repository instance
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Client Secret issued by the OpenID Provider. The API never returns this value on read, so Terraform cannot detect out-of-band changes to it.
- `email_claim` (String) Claim containing the user's email address
- `exact_match_claims` (Map of String) Claims that must exactly match the given value for authentication to succeed
- `first_name_claim` (String) Claim containing the user's first name
- `groups_claim` (String) Claim containing the user's group memberships, required for role mapping
- `idp_authorization_url` (String) Authorization endpoint of the OpenID Provider
- `idp_jwks` (String) Literal JSON Web Key Set (JWKS) document, as an alternative to idp_jwks_url
- `idp_jwks_url` (String) JSON Web Key Set (JWKS) endpoint of the OpenID Provider
- `idp_logout_url` (String) Logout endpoint of the OpenID Provider
- `idp_token_url` (String) Token endpoint of the OpenID Provider
- `last_name_claim` (String) Claim containing the user's last name
- `token_request_custom_params` (Map of String) Additional custom parameters sent with the token request
- `use_trust_store` (Boolean) Whether to validate the OpenID Provider's certificate using Nexus Repository's own truststore

### Read-Only

- `last_updated` (String) String representation of the date/time the resource was last changed

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Existing OAuth2/OIDC configuration can be imported as follows.
#
# NOTE: The Identifier (OAUTH2) in below example has no meaning and is just to comply with Terraform syntax.
# NOTE: client_secret is never returned by the API, so it will not be populated after import -
#       set it explicitly in configuration afterwards.

# Example
terraform import sonatyperepo_security_oauth2.oauth2_config OAUTH2
```
